defaultCampus.facts:
SUNY DELHI KNOWLEDGE PACK
Verified from official SUNY Delhi pages on 2026-07-30. Recheck dated or numeric claims before public release.

CORE IDENTITY
- Official public-facing name: SUNY Delhi. The institution is a public college of technology in the State University of New York system, located at 454 Delhi Drive, Delhi, NY 13753.
- SUNY Delhi describes its education as applied, hands-on, career-focused, and affordable.
- The college offers 60+ majors and programs across certificates, associate, bachelor's, and master's degrees, with campus, online, and selected partnership-site options.
- Current Fast Facts lists a 15:1 student-to-faculty ratio.

PROGRAM THEMES
- Major areas include nursing and health, veterinary science, hospitality and culinary arts, business, criminal justice, architecture and construction, automotive and skilled trades, mechatronics, welding, recreation and sports, and golf-related programs.
- Do not promise that a specific program, modality, credential, or start term is available without checking the current Majors and Programs page.

ADMISSIONS
- First-year students may apply through the SUNY Application or Common Application. SUNY Delhi uses rolling admissions until a program reaches its acceptance or enrollment limit.
- First-year application materials include an official high-school transcript or equivalency scores. Test scores are optional and may be considered for merit scholarships. Program prerequisites and space availability can affect admission.
- Admissions contact: 607-746-4550, enroll@delhi.edu, 118 Bush Hall. Application and visit details should link to the current SUNY Delhi site.

COST AND AID — 2026-27 FIGURES; VERIFY BEFORE USE
- Published estimated annual costs for a New York resident undergraduate are: $7,070 tuition, $2,052 on-campus student fees, $9,580 standard double-room rent, and $6,680 for the Unlimited + $350 meal plan; published total $25,382.
- SUNY Delhi states that students receive more than $31 million in financial aid each year.
- FAFSA school code: 002857. Published TAP codes are 3020 for certificate/associate programs, 6020 for bachelor's programs, and 5024 for graduate scholarship programs.
- Aid, scholarship, deadline, housing, meal-plan, and tuition claims are time-sensitive. Link to the current page and verify the applicable term before publishing.

OUTCOMES — INCLUDE THE SOURCE QUALIFIER
- Current Fast Facts reports that, among respondents to a Spring 2024 graduate/alumni survey with a 12% response rate, 76% were employed, 69% were employed full time, and 90% of employed respondents said their occupation related to their SUNY Delhi academic program.
- Do not generalize these survey results beyond respondents or remove the response-rate and survey-year qualifier.

APPROVED DESTINATIONS
- Main site: https://www.delhi.edu/
- Academics and program exploration: https://www.delhi.edu/academics/ and https://www.delhi.edu/academics/majors-programs/
- First-year application information: https://www.delhi.edu/admission/apply/first-year/
- Tuition and fees: https://www.delhi.edu/admission/tuition-fees/
- Financial aid: https://www.delhi.edu/admission/financial-aid/
- Financial-aid dates: https://www.delhi.edu/admission/financial-aid/deadlines/
- Fast Facts and outcomes: https://www.delhi.edu/about/fast-facts/

COMMUNICATION GUARDRAILS
- Prefer concrete next steps and direct official links.
- Distinguish prospective, admitted, current, online, graduate, and family audiences; do not blend requirements across them.
- Never invent deadlines, program requirements, scholarship eligibility, costs, outcomes, rankings, or accreditation claims.
- Flag anything involving FERPA, financial-aid eligibility, legal compliance, or individual student records for staff review.
